findings.evidence: The implementation is `def IsFiniteType (A : Matrix B B ℤ)`, whereas `roadmap/.../Suggested.lean:238` specifies `def IsFiniteType {B : Type*} [Fintype B] ...`. For infinite `B`, `A = 2 • 1` with constant positive symmetrizer has positive quadratic form on every nonzero finitely supported vector, so the omission materially enlarges the predicate.
findings.fix: Restore `[Fintype B]` as in the roadmap signature and add the corresponding finite-index assumption to consumers such as `submatrix`.
findings.issue: `IsFiniteType` has no `[Fintype B]` assumption; consequently an infinite diagonal matrix with every diagonal entry `2` satisfies this definition, despite being infinite rank.

summary: `IsFiniteType` omits the finite-index hypothesis, so it classifies infinite-rank Cartan matrices as finite type and does not match the pinned definition.
